{{Event infobox | level = 80 | location = Eternity's Garden | type = Meta event | requires = voe }} [[Shackles of the Ancients]] is a level 80 [[meta event]] that occurs in [[Eternity's Garden]], around [[The Forge (Eternity's Garden)|The Forge]] and [[The All Seer]]. == Event schedule == {{notice|We are aware this timer is currently incorrect following the recent game update, we are gathering data on the talkpage on event start times to confirm the pattern.}} {{Event timer|voe-eg|style=margin-right:280px;}} == Objectives == * ''The All Seer is calm.'' * ''The All Seer has awoken! Alliance forces are preparing to seize the forge.'' * ''Allies are gathering at Pilgrim's Rest.'' * ''Preparations begin in: 5:00.'' === The Forge === * ''Allies are attempting to sieze the forge from Inquest Control.'' ** {{event|Capture and hold the western chamber}} ** {{event|Capture and hold the northern chamber}} ** {{event|Capture and hold the eastern chamber}} ** ''Take control of all three chambers in the forge.
{{event bar | empty}} ** ''Defeat the augmented Inquest champions.: x/3'' * The Inquest will succeed in: 15:00 * ''The Alliance has taken the forge and are attempting to repair it.

Does failure one exist?}} ;Preparations begin :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Bad news. [[Inquest]] woke up the statue in the northern temple. Place is bleeding with miasma.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''The damn thing is protected by some sort of spell. Can't damage it.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Just another roadblock... Bet [[Director Vloxx|Vloxx]] loves that.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''[[The All Seer]], keeper of the [[seneschal]]s... Another example of the [[doyen]]'s desperation.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''I...have an idea. Grant me a moment to muster my strength.'' ;One minute before the start :'''Isgarren:''' ''[[Tribune]], what is the state of the forge?'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Eh, Inquest have it locked down, but that's a fight I could win with my claws trimmed. Why?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The artificers had a safeguard in case their creations lashed out. It was called "The Light of the Forge Masters."'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Perhaps it will allow us to damage the All Seer.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Sounds like a solution.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The [[Sidony's Curse|curse]] stings my every sense. I cannot fight with you...but I can cast a portal to get you into the forge.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''On my signal. I will instruct from afar.'' ;Meta start :'''Isgarren:''' ''There. A portal to the forge is open.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Seize control of the three forge chambers. With the structure secured, you will cast the Light of the Forge Masters.'' ;While assaulting the chambers :'''Overseer Kuda:''' ''The [[Tyrian Alliance]] is here. Keep them out of the forge! Or I'll assign you to [[Project 5388]].'' ;While assisting allies :'''(northern forge)''' {{section-stub|event|Missing dialogue.}} :'''(eastern forge)''' {{section-stub|event|Missing dialogue.}} :'''(western forge)''' ::'''Westergard:''' ''Don't lose focus. Keep 'em out.'' ::'''Westergard:''' ''Mess around with [[Hullgarden]], you get Westergard.'' ::'''Westergard:''' ''Heh. No better than a [[freebooter]].'' ;Once the chambers are secured :'''Overseer Kuda:''' ''Damn it! Get out of there, you dolts.'' :'''Overseer Kuda:''' ''(shrugs) At least I've found what I needed... A couple [[Augmented creature|tweaks]] and [[Torrs Calare|you'll]] do nicely.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The forge is secure.'' :'''(northern forge)''' ::'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Got it. Let's regroup with the others.'' :'''(eastern forge)''' ::'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''Finally. Let's head back.'' :'''(western forge)''' ::'''Westergard:''' '' 'Bout time. Let's go.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''What next, [[Wizard's Court|wizard]]?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''You'll need to power the forge. Given its present sedation, I imagine the pipework is in disarray.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Lots of steps just to fight the thing...'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''I challenge you to approach the All Seer without the sacred light. First, you'll lose all of your fur. Then, you'll die.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Repair the pipework. Got it.'' ;Upon repairing energy leaks :'''Isgarren:''' ''[[Magic]] is leaking from the pipework—your [[skimmer]], now! Its water jets may be able to push them in place.'' ;Once all the pipes have been repaired :'''Isgarren:''' ''Power is now flowing to the forge. Quickly, return to the others.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''You've only a brief window to summon forth the light.'' ;Once the forge is fully powered :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''(growls) The forge is chained.'' ;Upon attacking Kela's minions :'''Westergard:''' ''These things sure want to stop us, huh?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''These bindings were cast by the All Seer. It compelled the seneschal, too.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Quickly, defeat her spawn so you can unbind the forge!'' :'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''I really hate these things.'' ;Upon downing Kela's minion :'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''It's down!'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Dead. For now.'' ;Once Kela's minions and All Seer's chains are defeated :'''Isgarren:''' ''Now, repeat after me, Tribune. Sacro! Brucian! Fuoco!'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Sacro. Brucian. Fuoco.'' :''(The forge powers up and shoots a beam of light into the sky.)'' :'''Westergard:''' ''W-wow.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''I'll take that as a good sign. Isgarren?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Magnificent...'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Blessed by such a light, you can now safely pursue the All Seer. Bear in mind, it will not be an easy fight.'' ;Once the forge grants the power :'''Isgarren:''' ''With the last of my strength, I will cast another portal opposite your current position in the forge.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The portal is now...open. It will take you to the All Seer.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''End this.'' ;Upon reaching [[The All Seer]] :'''Isgarren:''' ''The All Seer will throw every defense it can at you.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''As we've learned, the surrounding feretories house the souls of [[seer]]s who offered their essence to protect the island.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Perhaps we can overburden and flood the All Seer by releasing them. Lamentable, but necessary.'' ;The first round ;Once the avatar is defeated (one of the following) :'''Isgarren:''' ''Now, overwhelm it!'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The feretory is vulnerable! Quickly, overwhelm it!'' ;Once the souls are released from the feretory :'''Isgarren:''' ''It's working, but careful now, it's growing more desperate to stop you.'' ;Upon attacking enhanced creatures :'''Isgarren:''' ''The All Seer has summoned the seneschals! Defeat its protectors and remove the chains.'' ;Once the chains have been severed :'''Isgarren:''' ''All of the chains have been severed. You must overwhelm the other feretories.'' ;The second round: ;Once the soul is defeated (one of the following) :'''Isgarren:''' ''Again, overwhelm it to release the souls!'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Strike now, while it's vulnerable!'' ;Once the soul is released from the feretory :'''Isgarren:''' ''It only grows more enraged, but success is near. The All Seer's dominion will soon end.'' ;Upon attacking enhanced creatures :'''Isgarren:''' ''Once more, eradicate the beasts!'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The All Seer has compelled the Seneschal of the Forest to its defense!'' ;Upon getting shackled :'''Isgarren:''' ''Free yourself of the All Seer's shackle!'' ;Upon getting linked with another player :'''Isgarren:''' ''The All Seer has tethered your essence with another to stifle you. Perhaps there is an advantage to exploit...'' ;Once all the creatures have been defeated :'''Isgarren:''' ''Steel yourself, [[Wayfinder]]! The All Seer is almost defeated, but its desperation fumes.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Shatter the chains and release these souls from [[Castora]] once and for all!'' ;Meta success :'''Isgarren:''' ''It is working.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Find peace, sleepless souls; your vigil has ended. Once this curse is lifted, my own watch will begin.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Don't let your guard down yet—'' :'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''Hold it, Rytlock. Look. Their shackles are gone too.'' :'''Westergard:''' ''That better, girl?'' :'''Kela, Seneschal of Waves:''' ''(purrs)'' :'''Westergard:''' ''Beautiful creature. Was I wrong about you?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The All Seer is defeated. They act on their own free will once again.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''And I...I feel a weight lifting. The bindings of this place are weaker.'' :'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Curse broken?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Soon.'' :'''Westergard:''' ''So... How many Inquest noses you break, Captain?'' :(one of the following) ::'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''Six. You?'' ::'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''Twelve. You?'' :(one of the following) ::'''Westergard:''' ''Thirteen.'' ::'''Westergard:''' ''Sixteen.'' :'''Sayida the Sly:''' ''Rytlock?'' :(one of the following) ::'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Twenty-four.'' ::'''Rytlock Brimstone:''' ''Thirty-one.'' == Related achievements == * {{achievement|Castoran Curse-Breaker}} * {{achievement|Cruel Creations}} * {{achievement|Eternal Watch}} * {{achievement|Rage of the Forest}} * {{achievement|Unexpected Allies}} {{Eternity's Garden nav}} [[es:Cadenas ancestrales]]
